# vim -u NONE -N: open, type two lines, quit with :q!
[vim-open]
size 80 24
alt true
visible true
cursor 0,0
row 0: ""
row 1: "~"
row 22: "~"

[vim-edit]
alt true
cursor 10,1
row 0: "hello vim"
row 1: "second line"
row 2: "~"

[end]
alt false
visible true
cursor 0,3
row 0: "shell line one"
row 1: "shell line two"
row 2: "after vim"
row 3: ""
